description: This file defines the BlockReferenceExpression class, which represents a block call node in the Twig template engine AST. It contains methods for compiling the expression for rendering or checking block existence, handling template nodes and arguments.

classes.name: BlockReferenceExpression
classes.description: Represents a block call node in Twig, allowing rendering or existence checks for template blocks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a block reference expression with a name node, optional template node, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to render the block or check its existence based on attributes.

methods.name: compileTemplateCall
methods.description: Helper method to compile a call to a template method like hasBlock, renderBlock, or yieldBlock.

methods.name: compileBlockArguments
methods.description: Prepares the argument list for the block call, including context and blocks.
